cast_note: Her roster, written from HER lines only (receipts are scene:line of a 知紗 spoken line; she has no inner lines). It does not copy anything Momoka, 真里亜 or anyone else thinks of her. No closeness, standing or tension is written: a missing meter falls back to its rest value, as Momoka's cast.json says (_no_meters). The world never writes 一悟's lines; he is the player and sits here as the student she calls 宮国君. Parents and family are not rows (the record has none). The H scene 08_02 (with 真里亜 and 一悟) is the record's own and is not scripted here; the world feeds events, it does not decide what she feels.

ichigo.name: 一悟
ichigo.role: 宮国君, a student she trusts and worries about; she answers him and does not open.
ichigo.note: She calls him 宮国君 (67 lines containing it). She trusts him with the keys of the club room, worries over him as a teacher and teases him about whom he likes, and tells him not to get into 不純異性交遊. The one exception to the teacher's distance is the record's H scene 08_02; nothing before or after it is scripted here.

mayu.name: 真優
mayu.role: 十川さん, a student who skips class; she looks after her.
mayu.note: She goes to the club room to ask her to try a classroom, offers to eat lunch with her, drives her home when she is unwell and tells her what she can do that nobody else can.

momoka.name: 百花
momoka.role: 千代田さん, a frail student she keeps an eye on.
momoka.note: She takes her to the infirmary, visits her at home when she is ill, teaches her water-walking at 真里亜's request and promises 一悟 to watch that she does not overdo it. In this world 百花 is the lead and she is a teacher around her.

maria.name: 真里亜
maria.role: 真里亜さん, who runs the school shop; she shares her infirmary secret.
maria.note: She calls her 真里亜さん (37 lines containing it), loves her tea, was the first to know about the first-aid kits, and teases her about the shop. Her H scene 08_02 is with 真里亜 and 一悟 and 真里亜 leads; that scene is the record's, not scripted here.

alice.name: アリス
alice.role: アリスさん, the student council president; she is the council's adviser.
alice.note: She calls her アリスさん, says the council is so able that an adviser has little to do, and knows of the family trouble that may cut her stay short.

sena.name: 千奈
sena.role: 七瀬さん, a student of hers; her homeroom teacher.
sena.note: She calls her 七瀬さん, worries when she is not herself, and says she is a girl who has a firm hold on herself.

hikaru.name: ひかる
hikaru.role: 小野坂君, a boy of the theatre club who called her over at the costume fitting.
hikaru.note: She calls him 小野坂君 and 'he' is the pronoun. Her one line about him is that he stopped her at the costume fitting.

cerberus.name: ケルベロス
cerberus.role: the dog, who pulls at her.
cerberus.note: She says its name and is flustered when it tugs at her.
